introduction: New Hampshire unemployment claims are managed through the NHUIS claimant system. File the initial claim and continue requesting each eligible week separately.
description: New Hampshire unemployment claims are managed through the NHUIS claimant system. File the initial claim and continue requesting each eligible week separately.

sections.who: NH Employment Security reviews covered earnings, separation circumstances and ongoing ability, availability and work-search requirements. Explain any severance or continued employment rather than assuming it has no effect.
sections.get: Approved benefits provide temporary income based on the claim determination. A claim record alone does not request payment for every future week.
sections.docs:
• Identity and Social Security details.
  • Employer names, employment dates and separation information.
  • Weekly earnings and other payments to report.
  • Work-search records and filing confirmations.
sections.apply:
1. Open the claimant application

    Use NHUIS claimant login or the File a Claim link through NH Employment Security.

  2. Complete the claim

    Answer the employment and payment questions and save the confirmation number.

  3. File weekly

    Report the agency’s Sunday–Saturday calendar week. Follow continuing eligibility and work-search instructions for your case.
sections.after: Read determinations and any appeal instructions promptly. If you resume work then become unemployed again within the same claim year, ask about reopening rather than automatically starting a duplicate claim.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using NHES claimant handbook, State filing-system rules. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.
